jackson2020.reference: the condition's stored reference: the six HO constructions summed

gene_rules.condition_sum: primary: a gene enters every pair of a condition when its UMIs summed over that condition's records reach the floor (one gene set per condition, every pair scored)
gene_rules.both_constructions: secondary: a gene enters a pair when it has >= floor UMIs in both constructions (pairs with < 20 such genes are not scored, so deep constructions are over-represented)

two_culture_mean_spearman_brown.note: derived, not measured: rel2 = 2 r / (1 + r) per gene, the reliability of the mean of two exchangeable cultures

kemmeren2014.decomposition_total_variance: first culture of each of 1480 mutants
kemmeren2014.definition: ceiling_g = sqrt(clip(r_g, 0, 1)) over genes with >= 3 paired mutants (expression_ceiling_all.py); decomposition rel_g = 1 - var(c1 - c2) / 2 / total_var_g

hu2007.reason: GEO GSE4654 holds one sample per strain: the error-model X score after weighted duplicate averaging; the per-array data went to the Longhorn Array Database and www.iyerlab.org/tfnetwork, never archived (torchcell/datasets/scerevisiae/hu2007.py module docstring)

paper.md.quote: Each experiment was independently carried out at least twice.
performed weighted duplicate averaging with custom Java software.

si/si8.md.quote: The repeatability of each gene's measured expression change across multiple independent biologically repeated experiments is the strongest input to the assignment of a confidence value.

definitions.concordance: fraction of 5000 bp grid points where the forward-filled called parents agree, over points defined in both
definitions.deviation_r: Pearson over genes (>= 10 UMIs on both sides) of log2 CPM minus the own panel's log2 CPM
definitions.posterior_fraction: marker-weighted fraction of a genotype's blocks whose posterior of the called parent is below the cut
